# pdf-lib 1.17.1 (vendored)

`pdf-lib.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/pdf-lib.min.js` of the npm package
`pdf-lib@1.17.1` (https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib), MIT licence — see
`LICENSE.md` beside it.

sha256: `0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f`

The bundle also carries its own dependencies, each under its own licence:
tslib (Apache-2.0, notice kept inside the file), pako (MIT and zlib),
@pdf-lib/standard-fonts (MIT) and @pdf-lib/upng (MIT).

Used only by Ship Day's "Print the day's paperwork" button
(`assists/ship-day/paperwork.js`), loaded on the Ship Day page only and never
from a CDN.
